content.summary: Two adult researchers share a sunrise walk whose near-touch remains incomplete. Preserve the five causal invariants and terminal proof while replacing all source-specific surfaces.

quick_start.input_format: One clearly adult subject and three identity anchors persist. + Every fragment contains one readable sensory action. + Environmental transitions preserve the island geography. + Handheld imperfections remain motivated and restrained. + The final close-up reconnects subject and opening location.
quick_start.recommended_input: Two clearly adult graduate researchers walk side by side toward a hill observatory at sunrise. They exchange one joke, one side glance each and keep the observatory centered ahead. Use one eye close-up, then return to both adults continuing toward the same observatory in silence.
